svg.title: The mutation tests
svg.desc: Infection changes the code of lib/ in one small way at a time, a mutant, such as a comparison that includes its limit or a call that is left out, and runs the unit tests that cover the changed line. When a test fails, the mutant is killed. When every test passes, the mutant escaped. If the change makes a difference, a test is missing, and a new test or a sharper assertion kills the mutant. If it makes none, it is an equivalent mutant, which infection.json5 lists with the reason. The score counts the killed mutants among all that aren't listed, and stays at 100 %.
